compact_mobile_note: Compact/mobile layouts preserve visible meaning and do not turn essential clarifications into hover-only or clipped help bubbles.
delivery_role_note: Bounded helper-disclosure surface for official voter-information routes that use tooltips, popovers, or similar help bubbles.
dismissible_hoverable_persistent_note: Custom hover/focus disclosures are dismissible, hoverable, and persistent enough to satisfy WCAG-aligned review.
durable_alternative_note: Critical clarifications also exist in inline text, expandable route content, or another deliberate durable help surface.
essential_info_visibility_note: Any rule that controls whether the voter proceeds or chooses another official path also appears in visible or otherwise durable text.
hover_focus_behavior_note: Hover/focus disclosures remain readable long enough to compare against the surrounding route and do not vanish immediately on pointer movement.
keyboard_touch_note: Keyboard and touch users can discover the same meaning without relying on desktop-only long-hover behavior.
overlay_collision_note: The disclosure does not cover the exact answer text or next-step control it is meant to explain.

reviewed_disclosures.durable_alternative_note: Visible inline helper text preserves the same meaning without requiring the tooltip.
reviewed_disclosures.reason_note: The tooltip briefly defines how initials and suffixes are treated, but the same rule is also stated in adjacent visible helper text.
reviewed_disclosures.trigger_label: What counts as a matching name?

reviewed_disclosures.durable_alternative_note: The same exception is repeated in visible route text and linked help content so the popover is not the only place where the rule exists.
reviewed_disclosures.reason_note: The popover explains a residence-vs-mailing-address exception that can change whether a voter should use the mail-ballot request path.

supplemental_only_note: Tooltip posture is reserved for short, non-critical helper text rather than governing deadlines, eligibility rules, or fallback instructions.
tooltip_popover_surface_label: Example tooltip/popover posture for official voter-information routes
tooltip_vs_popover_semantics_note: Brief non-interactive help uses tooltip posture; longer or more deliberate disclosures use explicit button-triggered popover/disclosure posture instead of pretending to be a tooltip.
trigger_discoverability_note: Help triggers are labeled or styled as interactive controls rather than decorative symbols or hover-only mysteries.
